    • Method Detail

      • search

        @NotNull
@NotNull List<SearchService.Result> search​(@NotNull
                                           @NotNull com.composum.sling.core.BeanContext context,
                                           @NotNull
                                           @NotNull String selectors,
                                           @NotNull
                                           @NotNull String root,
                                           @NotNull
                                           @NotNull String searchExpression,
                                           @Nullable
                                           @Nullable com.composum.sling.core.filter.ResourceFilter searchFilter,
                                           int offset,
                                           @Nullable
                                           @Nullable Integer limit)
                                    throws javax.jcr.RepositoryException,
                                           SearchTermParseException
        Fulltext search for resources. The resources are grouped if they are subresources of one target page, as determined by the parameter targetResourceFilter.

        Limitations: if the searchExpression consists of several search terms (implicitly combined with AND) this finds only resources where a single property matches the whole search condition, i.e., all those terms. If several resources of a page contain different subsets of those terms, the page is not found.

        Parameters:
        context - The context we use for the search.
        selectors - a selector string to determine the right search strategy, e.g. 'page'
        root - Optional parameter for the node below which we search.
        searchExpression - Mandatory parameter for the fulltext search expression to search for. For the syntax see QueryConditionDsl.QueryConditionBuilder.contains(String) . It is advisable to avoid using AND and OR.
        searchFilter - an optional filter to drop resources to ignore.
        Returns:
        possibly empty list of results
        Throws:
        javax.jcr.RepositoryException
        SearchTermParseException
        See Also:
        ResourceFilterMapping

      • executeQueryWithRaisingLimits

        @NotNull
@NotNull List<SearchService.Result> executeQueryWithRaisingLimits​(SearchService.LimitedQuery limitedQuery,
                                                                  int offset,
                                                                  Integer limit)
        Execute the query with raising limit until the required number of results is met. We don't know in advance how large we have to set the limit in the query to get all neccesary results, since each page can have an a priori unknown number of matches. Thus, the query is executed with an estimated limit, and is reexecuted with tripled limit if the number of results is not sufficient and there are more limits.
        Returns:
        up to limit elements of the result list with the offset first elements skipped.
